1. (Currently amended) A method of analyzing one or more plant embryos comprising: (a) collecting shed cellular material from one or more embryos by agitating the one or more embryos in a non-destructive medium __that does not disrupt the viability of the embryo__; (b) obtaining DNA from the shed cellular material __without prior cell wall disruption by enzymatic treatment__; (c) performing a molecular analysis of the DNA obtained in step (b); and (d) germinating at least one of said one or more embryos.

2. (Original) The method of claim 1 wherein the non-destructive medium consists essentially of water.

3. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 wherein the DNA is obtained by __lysing the shed cellular material through exposure to cold and then heat followed by agitation, wherein the cold temperature is below 0°C and the heat temperature is above 50°C__.

4. (Currently amended) The method of claim 3 wherein said cold, heat, and agitation steps are repeated __at least twice__.

5. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 wherein the DNA is obtained by __thermal lysis comprising heating of the shed cellular material to a temperature above 50°C and agitation__.

6. (Currently amended) The method of claim 5 wherein said heat and agitation steps are repeated __at least twice__.

7. (Cancelled)

8. (Cancelled)

9. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 wherein obtaining DNA from the shed cellular material comprises extracting the DNA __using a non-enzymatic extraction method__.

10. (Currently amended) The method of claim 9, wherein said extracting is performed by adding magnetic particles to the shed cellular material __in the absence of enzymatic cell wall degradation__.

11. (Original) The method of claim 1 wherein the one or more embryos comprise one or more immature embryos.

12. (Original) The method of claim 1 further comprising storing the one or more embryos prior to step (c) or (d).

13. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1, wherein said molecular analysis is genotyping __performed on DNA obtained without prior enzymatic cell wall disruption__.

14. (Original) The method of claim 13, wherein said genotyping occurs by way of: single nucleotide polymorphism detection, restriction fragment length polymorphism identification, random amplified polymorphic detection, amplified fragment length polymorphism detection, DNA sequencing, whole genome sequencing, allele specific oligonucleotide probes, or DNA hybridization to DNA microarrays or beads.

15. (Original) The method of claim 1 further comprising growing a germinated embryo into a plant and phenotyping the plant.

16. (Original) The method of claim 1 wherein prior to said molecular analysis, whole genome amplification is performed.

17. (Currently amended) The method of claim 13 further comprising selecting one or more embryos based on genotype __prior to any enzymatic treatment of the embryos__.

18. (Currently amended) The method of claim 17 further comprising germinating the one or more selected embryos __without prior enzymatic cell wall disruption__.

19. (Currently amended) The method of claim 18 wherein any of the steps resulting in selection of one or more embryos is automated __and wherein the method does not employ enzymatic cell wall degradation prior to genotyping__.
